$comment: EMPTY, and that is the finished state.
This roster opened on 2026-09-06 with FIVE credential-shaped literals -- the seaweedfs S3
identity and the loki + mimir x3 consumers presenting it back: one credential across five
coordinates. All five retired the same day under 081M1S6Z5S3087G0R000GEPSS2:
The value is drawn ONCE per cluster by `applyDevSharedSecrets` and written into
object-store, loki and mimir together -- logged nowhere, committed nowhere, dying with the
cluster. Aaron 2026-09-05: "passwords can be auto generated on cluster started never stored and
then just the same secrets can be injected to the pod that need them".
So `committed-chart-credentials.ts` is now a FLOOR AT ZERO: any new literal is OPEN and
fails. The file is kept rather than deleted because the audit reads it, and an empty roster
with its history says the credential was MOVED, not that nobody looked.
The key is file+path, so each entry retired itself the moment its coordinate stopped holding
a literal -- the audit reported all five as STALE before they were removed here.
